recognize_zh: 同一低倍視野裡有五顆嗜中性球，其中多顆核分成 5–6 葉、部分小葉呈環狀排列；多數嗜中性球都分葉過多，比單一細胞更能說明是真實的分葉過多而非偶發現象。
features: Five neutrophils in one low-power field, most with increased lobation
Several cells with 5-6 small rounded lobes, some arranged in a ring-like pattern
Condensed mature chromatin; cells of normal size
Pale cytoplasm with fine to moderately coarse granules
Background red cells normocytic, many with central pallor; platelets present
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low to medium power shows five neutrophils in a single field, the majority with five to six nuclear lobes, some arranged in a ring-like configuration. The neutrophils are of normal size with mature chromatin and fine to moderately coarse granules. Red cells appear normocytic without obvious macro-ovalocytes, and platelets are adequate in this field. Findings are consistent with neutrophil hypersegmentation involving many neutrophils; evaluation for vitamin B12/folate deficiency, drug effect, or an inherited trait is recommended.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic anemia usually shows accompanying macro-ovalocytes, anisopoikilocytosis, and cytopenias, which are not evident in this field.
Hereditary hypersegmentation affects most neutrophils in a well patient with normal B12 and folate and a positive family history.
Pelger-Huët neutrophils are hyposegmented with bilobed or round nuclei, the opposite of the multilobed nuclei here.
Ring neutrophils have a continuous annular nucleus without discrete lobes.
